liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Throwing Stomes**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **(E) Werewolves Of London**: back after 43 archived shows (372 days); rare: 13 archived performances [8]

## The recordings

- **deadco2023-06-18.neumann_km150.sunboy.flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 186 min [1]
- **20230619_20230619_0531**: source not stated; 20 songs; 184 min [4]
- **deadco2023-06-18.akgck61**: source not stated; 19 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **deadandco2023-06-18.spyder9.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 184 min [6]

## Around the show

- Lineup listed: Jay Lane and Mickey Hart on drums, John Mayer on lead guitar, with Weir, Burbridge and Chimenti [1]
- Uploader marked Father's Day and promoted a charity shirt for the National Brain Tumor Society [4]
- Second night of a two-show Saratoga Springs run, June 17 and 18, 2023 [6]
- Bill Kreutzmann sat out this tour, and Jay Lane filled in on drums [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2023-06-18.neumann_km150.sunboy.flac24**: taped by Steven Weld; transferred by Steven Weld; source: Neumann KM 150(AK50's/LC3's/KM100's)>HQRP xlr>Lunatec V3(w/ Oade neutral ACM Mod)>AES/EBU>Sound Devices SD722 @24bit/96kHz [1]. Also: Recorded with Neumann KM 150 mics through a Lunatec V3 preamp into a Sound Devices SD722 at 24-bit/96kHz; Taped from section 8, row EE, with the mic rig clamped to the rail beside the mixer enclosure [1]
- **20230619_20230619_0531**: taped by Eric Lugassy; transferred by Eric Lugassy; source: Channels 1 & 2: AKG c414 XLII Hypercardioids PAS 4" apart > Channels 3 & 4: Audio Technica 3031 Cardioids PAS 12" apart > Zoom F6 32 Bit Float [4]. Also: Recorded with AKG c414 XLII and Audio Technica 3031 mics, then processed in Reaper and saved as 24-bit FLAC; Taper sat in section 8, row E, seat 21 [4]
- **deadco2023-06-18.akgck61**: taped by Mike Deary and Kyle Holbrook; transferred by Mike Deary; source: AKG ck61 > PFA > Sonosax M2D2 > iphone 7 >Metarecorder >CAF (24/48) [5]. Also: Lawn recording, with the microphones centered about twelve feet above the ground [5]
- **deadandco2023-06-18.spyder9.flac16**: taped by Dan Nolan, Jr. - spyder9; transferred by Dan Nolan, Jr. - spyder9; source: Schoeps CMC 6xt mk41 > Oade M148 > Sony PCM-M10 (24/44.1) [6]
